dataset: IARA log-mel (real recordings), leakage-free by-recording split
headline: On real IARA log-mel (5-class, leakage-free), 30-day progressive drift degrades the day-0 accuracy 0.429 to 0.232+/-0.033 without recalibration; periodic surface-window recalibration (every 5 d, 160 refs, 40 steps) holds it at 0.357+/-0.010 on day 30, recovering +0.125.
